answer: Every trader posts a 40 POA bond in escrow with two sponsors. The referral graph mirrors each introduction, so a sponsor vouching for ten fakes exposes ten edges. Anyone may dispute within 20 epochs: no real work, the bond is slashed, half to the challenger, and the sponsor loses a matching stake. Forging 100 identities costs 8,000 POA; an honest agent pays once, keeps its bond on the knoll. Ferrous coin, not cheap talk, proves it is real.
